pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger analyst note on Ziwa Bank (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 146.73 for ZIW2. The note cites steady demand in the bank sector and cost control at Ziwa Bank (SYN). Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
